scenes.heading: TYPE A SCRIPT. GET A VIDEO.
scenes.say: Type a script. Pick an avatar. Get a finished video. No camera, no studio, no actors. HeyGen renders a photoreal AI avatar delivering your words — with lip-sync, voice cloning, and translation into one hundred seventy five languages.

scenes.heading: HEYGEN
scenes.say: It's called HeyGen. An AI video platform built around photoreal talking avatars. You write or paste a script, pick an avatar from two hundred stock options, or clone yourself from a two-minute video. Choose a voice. HeyGen renders the finished video in minutes.

scenes.heading: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.say: Step one: type or paste your script. Step two: pick an avatar — stock, custom digital twin, or Photo Avatar from a single image. Step three: choose a voice, or clone your own. HeyGen's engine maps audio to facial muscle movements for natural lip-sync, blinking, and micro-expressions. The video is ready to export.

scenes.heading: 175+ LANGUAGES · NATIVE LIP-SYNC
scenes.say: HeyGen translates your video into one hundred seventy five languages — and re-syncs the avatar's lips so it doesn't look dubbed. The original speaker's voice is preserved. One video, dozens of languages. Five point three million views on the topic this week.

scenes.heading: START CREATE
scenes.say: Go to heygen.com and create a free account. Pick an avatar, paste your script, and generate your first video in minutes. Higher tiers unlock the API, custom avatars, and integrations with Zapier, HubSpot, Canva, and Notion. There's even an MCP server for Claude and Cursor.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: HeyGen's avatars are impressive — Avatar IV is genuinely hard to distinguish from real footage. But it's still AI-generated video. For formal corporate training or legal content, you may still need a human presenter. And the free plan caps videos at one minute. But for marketing, social, and multilingual content, it changes the production math.
